description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for verifying the handling of Git submodule URLs, particularly focusing on URL validation and security aspects such as disallowed schemes, malformed URLs, and special character handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the given commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test case completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the command's output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timing or state as needed.
